sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/whitemountain/recreation/waterville-campground (+ 'Waterville campground site map.jpg'; last updated April 24, 2026; read 2026-11-23)

booking.source: recreation.gov catalog (sites 12-27 Site-Specific reservable; sites 2-6 and 8-11 not reservable) and rules (minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 14); FS page ('Some sites can be reserved ... Other sites are available on a first-come, first-served basis')

fees.source: FS page ('Single Site: $24 per night', 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $6 per vehicle per night'); recreation.gov rates $24 every site type 2026-2028; notice 'Site fee includes one RV with tow vehicle, tent sites include two vehicles. If space allows a third vehicle would be an additional fee'

sites.source: FS page ('It has 27 campsites') and site map (1 host, 2-27); recreation.gov catalog: 19 STANDARD NONELECTRIC (RV/Trailer 30 ft sites 5, 6, 9, 10, 12-19, 21, 24, 26; 25 ft sites 2, 3, 4, 8) and 6 TENT ONLY (11, 20, 22, 23, 25, 27). All 19 standard sites take 23 ft+; 11 of them reservable.

facilities.source: FS page ('Vault toilets'; 'Potable water is available at this site'); recreation.gov ('The facility provides the basic amenities of restrooms and drinking water. Many other amenities such as showers and laundry facilities are within a short drive')

values.note: Mid-May to mid-October; recreation.gov sells 2027 nights May 20 to October 11.

season.source: FS page (Seasons of Use 'Mid-May to Mid-October'); recreation.gov rates ('Peak Season 2027-05-20 to 2027-10-11')

discounts.source: FS page ('Senior and Access pass holders receive a 50% discount')

note: A quarter mile up Tripoli Road from NH-49, at the edge of Waterville Valley, in northern hardwoods between NH-49 and the Mad River; a store and gas are across Tripoli Road. A hikers' base: the Drakes Brook and Sandwich trails make a loop from near the campground. Two pets per site. --Claude
summary: FS page + site map + rec.gov 232179: 27 sites (19 RV spurs 25-30 ft, all fit 23 ft; 6 tent; host 1), $24 + $6 extra vehicle, vault toilets and water, no showers, mid-May to mid-October; sites 12-27 reservable, 2-11 first-come; 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimums. Not waterfront kept (Mad River beyond the loop, path to it).
flags: PHONE: 877-444-6777 (recreation.gov call centre) -> 802-289-0970 (recreation.gov: 'For facility specific information, please call (802) 289-0970', the concessionaire). recreation.gov's facility phone field shows 603-536-6100 (Pemigewasset RD).

PIN: stored 43.9419,-71.5092 = FS lat/long, inside the wedge between Tripoli Road, NH-49 and the Mad River where the FS site map draws the loop; the loop cannot be picked out under canopy. Kept. recreation.gov's per-site coordinates are wrong (they plot ~500 m north, across Tripoli Road on the town's buildings and lagoons) - do not use them.

Waterfront: not waterfront kept. FS map: the Mad River runs beyond the loop's far (north-west) side, reached by a 'Path' from sites 17-18; on Esri the river channel is ~15-25 m wide (creekside class at best) and well inside the forest from the pin; no site is drawn on the bank.
